prompts.named: Review `clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/internals/RecordAccumulator.java` for thread-safety problems. Name the method and the lines involved and explain the race.
prompts.natural: Can you review the Kafka producer's record accumulator, the part that appends records into batches per partition, for thread-safety problems? Name the method and lines involved and explain any race you find.
